result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now only collects active contributors. It compiles, but I didn't run any tests, and I didn't look for existing tests that cover this method.

The change is one condition in `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`. Unmatched contributors are now added to the remainder only if `contributor.getContributor().isActive()` is true. Dormant ones are skipped.

Contributors with a blank latest-commit date count as active, because `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange` already returns true for blank dates. Configured teams are untouched and keep all their members.
